summary: Tent camp on Wounded Doe Ridge, Clearwater National Forest: first manned 1923 or camped 1933 (sources differ), last manned 1939, now abandoned.

facts.status_note: Camp abandoned in 1939; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: First manned, from a tent camp, per the 1981 Lochsa history quoted on Forest Lookouts; the Forest Service list and firelookout.com date the camp to 1933.
Listed as a camp in 1933 by the Forest Service list and firelookout.com.
Manned by Keith McGee from a tent camp; never manned again after 1939.

evidence.supports: 1923 first manning, tent camp with Jess Mosher as lookout
evidence.quote: This point was manned for the first time in 1923 when Ranger Ralph Hand set in a tent camp with Jess Mosher holding down the lookout position.

evidence.supports: Communication by emergency wire to a telephone line
evidence.quote: Communication with the lookout was established by stringing emergency wire to the Fish Lake-McConnell Mtn. telephone line by the shortest route.

evidence.supports: 1939 manning by Hans Roeffler, tent camp, Keith McGee as lookout
evidence.quote: It was 1939 when Ranger Hans Roeffler manned Wounded Doe Ridge by setting up a tent camp with Keith McGee as lookout.

evidence.supports: Radio planned but did not work well
evidence.quote: This time communication was supposed to be by SPF radio, but due to malfunctions and static electricity interference, it didn't work out to well.

evidence.supports: Mirror-flash signals between McGee and Daland Broker on Rhoda Point
evidence.quote: McGee and Daland Broker, who was on Rhoda Point, arranged mirror flash signals to communicate after a fashion.

evidence.supports: Never manned again after 1939; dropped from the fire plan
evidence.quote: The point was never manned again after 1939 and was eventually dropped from the fire plan.

evidence.supports: firelookout: 19 miles southwest of Powell Ranger Station
Idaho Fire Lookouts: hike-in tag, abandoned
Forest Service list: Clearwater lookouts list (includes Wounded Doe)

evidence.quote: List compiled by Margaret Sand, Walde Lookout and Cindy Schacher, Archaeologist June 2016

evidence.supports: FFLA county list: Wounded Doe, Idaho County, camp abandoned

notes_for_editor: Start date conflict, not resolved: 1923 first manning with a tent camp (1981 Lochsa history, quoted on Forest Lookouts; the source is Louis Hartig's Historic Facilities of the Lochsa Ranger District, read second-hand) against a 1933 camp (Forest Service 2016 list, firelookout.com). The story gives both. Idaho Fire Lookouts also lists staff for 1922 (Jess Mosher, Hugh Curry) and 1923 (Jess Mosher), which the Forest Service quote does not mention; not written into the story. Forest: firelookout.com says Clearwater/Nez Perce National Forests; the record and story use Clearwater. Record point (46.30028, -115.02639) is about 2.9 km from the point the FFLA list and firelookout.com give (46.32582, -115.01810); no correction proposed. Elevation is unknown ('?' on both pages).
